main_body: A bare, gothic dead tree: a vertical trunk with a flared root base and several bare branches, with three dark crows perched in the branches. There is no canopy.
top_band: none - an organic trunk and branches with no horizontal top surface. The pixel column through the trunk runs from branch forks down the brown bark to the root flare, with no top band.
evidence: This is an organic tree. The trunk and branches are cylindrical forms with no horizontal surface to judge, and the only flat shape is the small root base at the bottom. The trunk reads as a plausible tree seen from a slightly raised camera. Under the organic kind the object is acceptable as a plausible 3/4 object, with no receding side faces and no flat architectural elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate is a bare dead tree, so it has no leaf canopy, whereas the references are full leafy trees with 5-6 green steps and clumped leaf texture. The bark has about 4 brown steps (dark outline, dark, mid, light), and the outline is a dark brown tint, not near-black. Bark texture is modest: some vertical grain and a knot hole, with small green moss patches near the base. The trunk is shaded one value per band and the branches are fairly flat in tone, so per-tile density is slightly below the references. It reads cleanly and in keeping with the style, but it is thinner than the reference in steps and texture.
